tools.name: explain_document
tools.description: Explains a contract, official letter, tax assessment or terms-and-conditions document in plain language, clause by clause. The document can be sent as plain text, as a base64-encoded PDF, or as base64-encoded photos of its pages. Send exactly one of the three. Scans and phone photos without a text l

tools.name: get_explanation
tools.description: Fetches the result of an explain_document call that was still running. Pass the analysis_id it returned.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: explain_document · Private data: explain_document · Public sink: explain_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: explain_document · Private data: explain_document · Public sink: explain_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "explain_document" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
